description: This PHP script manages the migration process for vtiger CRM, including database connection checks, file uploads, and migration steps based on user input.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles the migration process, including setting database parameters and executing migration steps.

classes.name: PearDatabase
classes.description: Database abstraction class used for database connections and operations.

methods.name: setOldDatabaseParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for the old database to be migrated.

methods.name: setNewDatabaseParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for the new database to migrate to.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Performs the migration process from old to new database or from dump file.

methods.name: modifyDatabase
methods.description: Modifies the existing database structure based on new parameters.
